findings.summary: PBR variant grouping allocated a combined copy of every large vertex/fragment pair and then recomputed the same pipeline hash for the manifest; it now groups by the stable digest, verifies collisions, and reuses that digest without changing emitted identities
DataLoweringContext required isDefaultLibraryIdentifier even though the data lowerer never consumed it; the unused interface requirement is removed
The shader-pair delimiter was stored as an actual NUL byte, causing Git to render the TypeScript source as binary; it is now an equivalent escaped NUL literal

The simplify gate excluded only untracked review records from its content hash, so committing valid evidence invalidated itself; committed and working diffs now exclude the review directory as documented, with a repository-level regression test
